## Ismailova et al. (2016), Fe-deficient bridgmanite 300 K BM2

**untested** (not refittable) · `fe088sio3_bridgmanite_ismailova_2016_300k_bm2` · `BM2` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/fe088sio3_bridgmanite.md#record-fe088sio3_bridgmanite_ismailova_2016_300k_bm2)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Supplementary Table S2 bundles only four selected crystallographic states, while Figure 3A plots substantially more compression and decompression markers for the published BM2 fit. The source gives no complete row list, inclusion/exclusion flags, regression objective, numerical weights, or row-wise Ne calibrant volumes. The four exact rows are checkpoint data, not a defensible reconstruction of the source fit input.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** fe088sio3\_bridgmanite\_ismailova\_2016\_table\_s2\_selected\_crystallography
